rows.grounds: instrumental plural of compound ketakī-mālatī-puṣpa; means used for perfuming
object of perfuming, prepared in prior steps
describes the ash as made beautiful or adorned

items.question: What final perfuming with flowers completes the prepared ritual ash?
premises: The ash has already been prepared and dried in the consecrated fire.
Ketaki and malati flowers are specified as the perfuming agents.
The prescribed action is to perfume the ash.
items.inference: The prepared ash is completed by perfuming it with ketaki and malati flowers.
items.plain_english: One should perfume the beautified ash with ketaki and malati flowers.
